Edit the attached PLEX UI screenshot into a finished, exceptionally polished DARK SPACE COMIC web interface concept. This is ONE independent wide cropped UI strip, straight-on and flat, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no comparison board, no invented extra page content. Keep approximately the original very wide aspect ratio, all existing labels, Chinese text, data and controls; use readable crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, no text shadow, no text outline, no blurred or duplicated letters. Palette: space navy #07131F, solid panel blue #11263A, raised panel #19364B, bright cyan #55EEE9, pale gold #F6CD68, offwhite #EEF7FF, dark ink #020B14. Premium comic language: 2–3 px crisp ink keyline plus cyan edge, restrained 4px hard offset shadow, slightly irregular rounded comic-panel corners, badge icons, halftone ONLY in small empty corners. Large quiet solid-blue areas for content; faint planets and sparse tiny four-point stars in the background. No photoreal planets crossing text, no aggressive neon glow, no dense particles, no motion blur. Keep the hierarchy and horizontal composition of the source. All Chinese text must be exact and legible. This is one of five coordinated concepts; use the same design language throughout. No new rewards, analytics, functions or headings beyond the specified existing copy.
TARGET: image 1 is the hero screenshot, image 2 is supporting mascot identity reference (not another UI). Wide hero banner, target roughly 2100 x 450 aspect 4.67:1. Left 70% is a spacious comic mission opening. Small label EXACT “Explorer · 学生1”. Large one-line headline EXACT “今天从一条清晰的学习主线开始”. Supporting sentence EXACT “你当前累计 24000 XP，今日委托已开启 0/5，完成全部可获得 150 XP 反馈。” Cyan dark-ink bordered primary button EXACT “进入探索舱”. Right 30% a beautiful thick cyan circular navigation instrument medallion with concentric thin ring and sparse tick marks, display “100” and “%”, pale gold compact ribbon below “传奇 Explorer”, footer EXACT “24000 / 24000 XP · 本周 +0”. Place a SMALL ink-drawn comic version of the existing Xiao E robot beside the lower left edge of the instrument, white rounded helmet, dark visor with two cyan eyes, teal crest, circular ears, white cape with teal trim and four-point star, friendly, no antenna ball, not a giant mascot. Match its identity to image 2 but show front/three-quarter face. A faint outlined planet and 2–3 small stars behind instrument only. Do not reduce headline readability to fit the illustration. Entire outer frame visible, with a narrow dark margin.
